existingDispositions.rationale: Habit-strength composites include automaticity items and the definition already specifies reduced deliberation. Contemporaneous composite/subscale correlation cannot establish independent cause.
Stronger cue-response links may facilitate particular initiation features, but whole PSY-071 automaticity is multidimensional and may share priming/latency indicators with the source.

An assigned if-then planning operation is not a measured increase in PSY-075 strength. Cue accessibility and cue-response association are different mediator candidates; performance does not identify both.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Stable-cue behavioral repetition increases Habit Strength.
gapQuestions.rationale: Longitudinal change/repetition association does not isolate repetition from motivation, context and reporting; candidate EA0014 remains UNKNOWN.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Frequency is identical to habit.
gapQuestions.rationale: Repeated deliberate behavior can remain goal-directed; context-linked automatic propensity requires independent evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Habit scale causes its automaticity subscale.
gapQuestions.rationale: Overlapping measurement items are not temporal causal mechanisms.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: An automaticity self-report gain increases every PSY-071 dimension.
gapQuestions.rationale: Same Layer feature-scope problem: speed, efficiency, awareness and intention not all verified.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: If-then planning strengthens a cue-response link.
gapQuestions.rationale: Exact priming contrast and current-cue scope needed; plan assignment and PSY-075 strength are distinct. EA0015 records unresolved effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Plan→cue accessibility→response association→behavior is a transmitted pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Parallel mediators reported in regression are not identified sequential causal segments.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A habit forms in exactly66days for everyone.
gapQuestions.rationale: Curve fits and conditional successful-learner summaries vary and can extrapolate beyond observed84days.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Pre/post intervention meta-analysis proves randomized causal benefit.
gapQuestions.rationale: Within-arm change is not a control-adjusted intervention contrast.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: No routine/time-cue difference proves both outperform no planning.
gapQuestions.rationale: Both randomized conditions received planning; no untreated comparator.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Acute stress increases habitual control.
gapQuestions.rationale: Original positive effect conflicts with task-limited exact replication and other paradigm nulls; stress exposure not PSY-054 appraisal.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Failed devaluation proves absence of all real-world habits.
gapQuestions.rationale: Assay sensitivity and goal-directed learning failure can obscure or mimic habits.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Stress modifies REL-PSY-035 cue-link→automaticity.
gapQuestions.rationale: No independent exact edge interaction, aligned dimension and timing established.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Relocation reduces Habit Strength.
gapQuestions.rationale: Relocation not randomized; intervention effects on behavior not exact habit weakening. Opportunity change may block expression without erasing association.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Travel/membership delta scientifically proves habit deletion.
gapQuestions.rationale: Scenario configuration is not subjective propensity or empirical consequence evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: App reminders strengthen habit.
gapQuestions.rationale: Small micro-randomized trial suggests combined prompts+commitment; component effect and self-report latent construct require separation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Commitment and reminders each inherit their package's efficacy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Joint condition does not establish independent component effect or synergy without exact contrast.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Observing pain consequences changes Observationally Learned Expectancy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Pain-intensity prediction following cues is not necessarily the canonical action-outcome probability; naturalistic clinical transfer not supported.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A placebo label implies a distinct observation identity and positive efficacy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reviews used similar high/low cue manipulations under placebo/nocebo labels; identity is operation, not result label.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Changing reward probability raises the entire Reinforcement Expectancy profile.
gapQuestions.rationale: Probability and subjective value may diverge; existing multidimensional feature-scope gap applies.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Observational expectancy is narrower than Outcome Expectancy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Potential acquisition-route qualification, but exact scope must align expected consequence/probability and source attribution; no formal record from recall labels.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reinforcement Expectancy duplicates Outcome Expectancy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reward-contingent probability/value profile versus broader consequence expectation require scope comparison; no merge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reward sensitivity trait equals current reinforcement expectancy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Stable responsiveness to rewards and current probability/value belief are different.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Action+coping planning creates higher-order shopping habit.
gapQuestions.rationale: Package and higher-order definition differ from atomic repetition or if-then plan; six-month effect promising but exact matched habit measure needs extraction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Culture shapes habitual cue dependence.
gapQuestions.rationale: No exact cultural-Driver contrast found in bounded search; country/context is not randomized culture or canonical entity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Habit is a qualified state that transforms into automaticity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Different overlapping constructs do not literally transform into one another.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Goal strength moderates REL-PSY-036.
gapQuestions.rationale: Performance interaction in SRC114 is not an exact intention-strength→association effect; measured goal strength and primed goal activation differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Imitation performance directly measures action-outcome expectancy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Observed reproduction, incentive-sensitive performance and expected consequence likelihood differ; Bandura1965 screened only bibliographically.

contribution.reconciliation: One practice contribution; do not add a second automaticity effect from overlapping scale items or inferred habit→automaticity propagation.
